facts.fact: Eravi asks Neela how many members the Resin House holds and on which day she will read the pages back, though she has told only Devan, Pavi, Bhaskaran and Thilak of a reading day. She files it unanswered.
facts.why: needed because the outline has Eravi ask these questions; the note that no one at the fort should have known sharpens the nightbark clue without naming him as the key-holder.
